hero: The engineering core of ACM-VIT, building the software and infrastructure that every project and event depends on.
description: Tech is the engine room of ACM-VIT. We build every app, website, portal, backend and game that powers our projects and events, from flagship hackathons to internal tools nobody outside the chapter ever sees.

Students here work across app development, web development, FOSS, game studios and DevOps. Pick any ACM-VIT event you have heard of, the portal, the contest backend, the live app, the dashboards holding it all together, and somebody in this domain wrote it.
footerMessage: Ship the thing. Then ship the thing that ships the thing.
